_note: This board is the whole 1440 shell with the create-component modal over
it. `press` types one character into the Name field before the read: the
submit is disabled while the name is empty, and a disabled button is grey,
so measuring it unfilled would compare the board's accent fill against a
state the board is not drawing.
THE MODAL HALF OF THIS BOARD IS NOT CONFORMED, and the reason is the
precedence rule rather than taste. 642:3375 draws a 440-wide dialog with:
Name (one field)
Scope        -> a Select reading 'This site'
a checkbox   -> 'Replace 18 matching groups with instances'
Neither of the last two has anything behind it. ComponentManager
createComponent(name, elementId, options) takes description, category,
tags, variantProperties and prefillFromDs — there is no scope parameter,
components are already per-project, and nothing in the engine can find
'matching groups' to replace. Building both would be new behaviour, and
behaviour is decided by the CODE contract. boards.json already carries
this as 'drift-modal-structure-differs-wholesale'.
The board also points AWAY from its own sketch: node 1170:4815 on this
frame is 'hotspot/state · Components · create-modal', linking to board
1170:4777 — which draws the modal the code actually ships, field for
field. A board that links out to another board for a state is not the
authority on that state.
WHAT THE BOARD WON HERE (changed in code): the modal's footer buttons.
642:3397 and 642:3399 both draw 28h with a 12/6 inset and an 8px radius —
the design system's Button 9:102, the same geometry its instance carries
on 641:2597. The footer was capping height at 28 and leaving flowbite's
20/10 padding, so the buttons were the right height in the wrong shape.
MODAL_FOOT_CLASS now sets both, next to the h-7 that was already there.
MEASURED BUT NOT JOINED:
modal   642:3375 says 440 wide, radius 8. The shipped modal is 720
(ModalContent size='lg') with radius 12 from MODAL_FRAME_BASE.
The width follows the field set, and the field set is the code
contract above; the radius belongs to chrome-ui's Modal, tuned
against seven other modal boards.
drawer  642:3152's --flowbite/gray/100 edge is real, but `.ls-panel`
reports a four-value border-color (only the right edge is set),
which normalises to a string no colour comparison can read. The
instrument cannot answer, so it is not asked.
canvas  642:3180 fills the canvas well --flowbite/gray/50 with a 32px
bottom inset; live is --bk-bg-subtle at 20px all round. That is
the canvas surface, drawn on every shell board in the family and
owned by the shell recipe, not by this one — changing it here
would move a surface twelve other boards also draw.

CONTRAST SCOPE CORRECTED 2026-09-08: was "[data-testid=\"overlay-scrim\"]", which resolved to a subtree holding none of the text under test — ModalRoot PORTALS to the overlay root, so a probe-, scrim- or panel-scoped selector contains no part of the dialog. It reported 0 contrast failures from an empty sweep, which is indistinguishable from a clean screen. `body` is the honest scope for a portalled subject: it covers the dialog and the shell behind it, which is what a person sees. measure.mjs now exits 3 on an empty sweep rather than banking the zero.

COACH DISMISSAL ADDED 2026-09-08. This recipe passed until the S1 arc FIXED the onboarding credit bug: useComposerInit's bootstrap emitted page:created for a page the user never made, so the checklist started at 1/7 and `showCoach` — which requires completedCount === 0 — was false for every user who ever existed. With the credit corrected the coach finally renders, and it is a fixed 240x154 bubble at x72-312 / y152-306 that covers the Insert drawer's first six rows. `waitFor` on an Insert row still passes; the CLICK times out on an intercepted pointer. Dismissing it first is what a person does. That the coach covers the drawer at all is the live half of authority=open:first-run-drawer and is NOT fixed by this step.
